stem.text: A student investigates a spring. The variation of the length of the spring with the force applied to the spring is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of length/m (vertical axis, ticks 0.20, 0.40, 0.60) against force/N (horizontal axis, tick 2.4). A straight line rises from the vertical axis; dashed guide lines mark 0.60 on the length axis and 2.4 on the force axis.

stem.text: What is the spring constant of the spring?
